description: Reconcile drift rooms/photos, move floorplan coordinates into D1, rebuild the floor-plan page (all dots + hover/click room cards + sidebar level switch), restructure the room viewport (smaller hero + change-hero modal, live stat cards, full-width overview/options/budget, media modal, reusable scroll TOC, supporting-materials table + upload), extend the planning/task API, and add Workers-AI text helpers.
stack: Cloudflare Worker + Astro SSR + Hono(zod-openapi) + Drizzle/D1 + Workers AI + R2 + Cloudflare Images; React islands + shadcn/@base-ui; dark Monolith theme.
conventions: No mock/placeholder data — all data from real API calls.
Dark Monolith theme, no traditional 1px borders.
AI prompts via ES6 template literals, never .join('\n').
Schema migrations via `pnpm run db:generate`; never hand-edit generated SQL.
Split any file approaching 1000 lines into modules before continuing.
New endpoints registered with @hono/zod-openapi (Zod v4) and visible in /openapi.json.

tasks.title: Add floorplan coordinate columns to rooms schema
tasks.detail: Add floorplanFloorKey (text), floorplanXPct (real), floorplanYPct (real). Run `pnpm run db:generate`. No barrel change (existing file).
tasks.acceptance: Migration generated; `wrangler types` clean; columns nullable.

tasks.title: Build reconcileRooms service (merge/rename/setPosition/reassignImages/deleteRoom)
tasks.detail: Repoint ALL room_id-referencing rows source->target then delete source. Enumerate room_id tables via sqlite_master/pragma at runtime. Dedupe inspirational_image_rooms (image_id,room) uniques and keep target room_ai_summaries. Idempotent + transactional.
tasks.acceptance: Unit-callable; merging a source moves images, inspirational links, docs, action items, summaries, scenario plans, budget links, planning tasks; no orphan rows; safe to re-run.

tasks.title: Author idempotent data-fix script encoding the exact L1-L8/U1-U10 mapping
tasks.detail: Encode Section 4.1 mapping (renames, merges, deletes, floor moves to outside=233121, the entryway split keeping image ids fd965547 & 4ce41f86 on street-front-door, moving rest to lower-foyer; move ce4f317d & 4ac13ec3 to upper-dining-room; move 22cef674 & a2a0d96c to upper-stair-landing; hard-delete duplicate images 4a06d3af & 1343677a via DELETE /api/images/:id path). Guard every statement (re-runnable).
tasks.acceptance: Dry-run on a copy reproduces Section 4.2 final room set; total listing+inspiration preserved minus the 2 intended deletes.

tasks.title: Seed floorplan coordinates (Section 4.2 table)
tasks.detail: Write Section 4.2 coordinates into new columns. outside-backyard xy=null. upper-dining-room=(84,62) per user (same X-axis as upper-living-room, mid quad-2). Update home-catalog seed so future seeds carry coordinates + final room codes (so re-seed won't recreate canonical drift).
tasks.acceptance: Every kept room has correct floor_key + xy (or null for outside-backyard); catalog seed reflects final codes.

tasks.title: Backup + execute reconciliation against remote D1, verify counts
tasks.detail: `wrangler d1 export DB --remote --output=backup-pre-0005.sql`; run the data-fix; verify before/after photo totals; confirm 18 placed rooms + outside-backyard exist and drift IDs gone.
tasks.acceptance: Backup saved; post-run room set matches plan; family-room & guest-bedroom photos now resolve to correctly-positioned rooms.

tasks.title: Harden against drift recurrence
tasks.detail: Confirm no path auto-creates rooms by free-text name. If found (e.g. decision-room / AI mapping), route through a canonical-slug resolver against existing rooms.
tasks.acceptance: No code path inserts a new room from an arbitrary display name without explicit admin intent.

tasks.title: Make SelectValue render display label, not value/id (reusable)
tasks.detail: Enhance shared SelectValue wrapper to map value->label (items/getLabel/renderValue prop) per @base-ui semantics. Fix the representative-photo select (RoomViewApp.tsx:547). Audit other Select usages remain correct.
tasks.acceptance: Selecting an option shows its name in the trigger everywhere; no regressions in GlobalUploadWidget/SupportingDocuments selects.

tasks.title: Task list/filter/search + status-count endpoints
tasks.detail: GET /api/planning/tasks?roomId=&status=&priority=&q=&epicId=&page=&pageSize=; GET /api/planning/tasks/stats?roomId= -> {open,in_progress,blocked,delayed,done,total}. Zod v4, zod-openapi registered.
tasks.acceptance: Endpoints return live planning_tasks; visible in /openapi.json; room-scoped filtering works.

tasks.title: Kanban / Gantt / Calendar / Projects endpoints
tasks.detail: GET /board (grouped by status), /timeline (start/due/deps), /calendar?from&to, /projects (epics-as-projects with rollups; CRUD gaps filled). All room-scopable.
tasks.acceptance: Each endpoint returns shapes sufficient to render kanban/gantt/calendar/dashboards from real data.

tasks.title: AI text service: improveDescription / summarizeDocumentForRoom / summarizeRoomOptions
tasks.detail: env.AI instruct model; ES6 template-literal prompts. Routes: POST /api/ai/improve-description; POST /api/supporting-documents/:id/room-summary (cache to aiRationale/metadata); POST /api/rooms/code/:roomCode/options-summary.
tasks.acceptance: Each returns improved/summarized text; document room-summary cached; prompts use real newlines.

tasks.title: Extend /api/rooms/catalog with coordinates, counts, hero, dimensions
tasks.detail: Return floorplanFloorKey/xPct/yPct, listingCount, inspirationCount, heroImageUrl, formatted dimensions + sqft per room so dots+cards need no extra fetch.
tasks.acceptance: Catalog payload powers all dots and hover cards in one request.

tasks.title: Decompose FloorplanGalleryApp into submodules
tasks.detail: Extract dot, hover/sticky card, and sidebar; keep each <400 lines.
tasks.acceptance: No behavior change yet; files modular.

tasks.title: Render all dots (both levels) from DB coordinates
tasks.detail: Remove hardcoded ROOM_COORDINATES_BY_CODE; show every placed room's dot for both levels simultaneously; null-coord rooms render no dot.
tasks.acceptance: All placed rooms show dots regardless of selected level.

tasks.title: Dot hover card + click-to-pin (sticky)
tasks.detail: Card: hero image, room name, #listing, #inspiration, sqft+measurements, View Room button -> /rooms/{code}. Hover shows; click pins until dismissed/another dot. Touch = tap-to-pin.
tasks.acceptance: Hover and click behaviors work on desktop + touch; View Room navigates.

tasks.title: Move level control to sidebar as a toggle Switch (no reload, dots unchanged)
tasks.detail: Remove header button-group; add shadcn Switch (Lower/Upper) to sidebar that only filters the sidebar room list. Add 'Outside / Unplaced' group for null-coord rooms.
tasks.acceptance: Toggling switch changes only the sidebar list; dots stay; no page reload.

tasks.title: Delete Inspiration Highlights + Room Launch Board
tasks.detail: Remove both bottom cards (current lines ~379-422 and ~424-487) and dead data.
tasks.acceptance: Sections gone; no unused imports/state.

tasks.title: Floor-plan mobile responsiveness
tasks.detail: Add base/sm breakpoints; image scales; sidebar stacks; dots tappable; hover-card becomes tap sheet/popover. Verify 375px.
tasks.acceptance: Usable and legible at 375/768/1024px.

tasks.title: Decompose RoomViewApp into section components
tasks.detail: Split the ~1050-line monolith into section components; RoomViewApp becomes a layout/orchestrator.
tasks.acceptance: Behavior preserved; each file <400 lines.

tasks.title: Smaller top-right hero + Change-hero modal
tasks.detail: Shrink hero, move top-right. 'Change room hero image' button -> modal with listing-photo card rows, current hero checkmarked, select moves checkmark + live-updates thumbnail, Cancel/Save; Save -> PATCH /api/rooms/code/:roomCode/profile + shadcn success (no browser alert).
tasks.acceptance: Hero changes persist and refresh; confirmation is shadcn-only.

tasks.title: Stats row (Budget Range / Estimate count / Task Progress), clickable anchors
tasks.detail: Three live stat cards; Task Progress from /api/planning/tasks/stats?roomId= (fallback room_action_items). Clicking smooth-scrolls to its section. No mock data.
tasks.acceptance: Stats reflect live data; clicks jump to sections.

tasks.title: Room Overview full-width + edit-in-modal (refresh AI)
tasks.detail: Full-width overview; top-right Edit opens Refresh-AI-summary (prompt + voice) modal using POST /api/rooms/code/:roomCode/summary. Remove standalone refresh card.
tasks.acceptance: Overview full width; refresh only via modal; summary updates.

tasks.title: Room Options (thumbs-up empty state OR raw+AI-summary tabs)
tasks.detail: If no deviations: 👍 + friendly message. Else tabs: raw (default) + ✨ AI Quick Summary via /api/rooms/code/:roomCode/options-summary.
tasks.acceptance: Both states render; AI tab summarizes live content.

tasks.title: Budget Signals full-width: stat cards + paginated/searchable/filterable table
tasks.detail: Rebuild @coss/p-table-4 (TanStack) to Monolith. Live budget items; add GET /api/rooms/:roomId/budget-items?search=&status=&page=&pageSize= (or paginate detail payload). No mock.
tasks.acceptance: Table paginates/searches/filters over live budget items.

tasks.title: Room Media modal (gallery/masonry/list; delete bento) + hero entry buttons
tasks.detail: Move media into a Dialog. Hero buttons: Listing (badge count) + Inspiration (badge count) open it pre-filtered. Toggle Gallery/Masonry/List only; remove Bento option + GridBento usage (delete component if unused). Close X top-right + Close bottom-right.
tasks.acceptance: Modal opens filtered; three views work; bento gone.

tasks.title: Reusable sticky scroll-progress Table of Contents
tasks.detail: Reusable component (items:{id,title,level}[], className, scrollAreaRef). Right-side, scrolls with user, active-section highlight. Section ids match stat anchors. Collapsible on mobile.
tasks.acceptance: TOC tracks scroll + jumps to sections; reusable elsewhere.

tasks.title: Delete listing/inspiration images (D1 + Cloudflare Images) from the room viewport
tasks.detail: Per-image Delete control in the media modal (and image context menu). shadcn AlertDialog confirm (no window.confirm). Listing photo: DELETE /api/images/:id (removes D1 row + Cloudflare Images asset). Inspiration photo (multi-room): offer two actions — 'Remove from this room' (unmap via PUT /api/images/:id with roomIds minus current) vs 'Delete permanently everywhere' (DELETE /api/images/:id). Surface images.is_duplicate as a badge so duplicates are easy to spot/cull. On success: shadcn toast + refresh counts/lists.
tasks.acceptance: Deleting a listing photo removes it from D1 and Cloudflare Images; inspiration offers unmap vs hard-delete; duplicate badge visible; lists/counts refresh; no browser dialogs.

tasks.title: Move/reassign photos to the correct room (button + modal journey)
tasks.detail: A 'Move / reassign photos' button opens a modal: thumbnail multi-select of the room's listing OR inspiration photos, a target-room picker (from /api/rooms/catalog, using the fixed Select that shows room display names), and Apply. Listing photos = single-room reassign (PUT /api/images/:id roomId, or POST /api/images/mapping/apply). Inspiration photos = add/replace room mappings (PUT roomIds). shadcn confirmation; refresh source + target counts. No mock data.
tasks.acceptance: Selected photos move to the chosen room; both rooms' listing/inspiration counts update; picker shows names not ids; works for listing and inspiration.

tasks.title: Supporting materials table with filename preview modal + type badge + date + description + AI summary
tasks.detail: Table columns per spec. Filename -> preview modal (image inline; PDF embed; Google Drive/Docs iframe) with Close + Open-in-new-tab. AI summary column generated on load via /room-summary endpoint (cached). Room-scoped list via ?roomId=.
tasks.acceptance: Table lists live docs; previews render by type; AI summaries appear.

tasks.title: Upload: dropzone + intake form (single/multi) + AI description + progress + per-file error/retry
tasks.detail: Dropzone -> stage -> intake (single=form, multi=rows): name(prefill), type(auto MIME), date(auto), description(✨ improve via /api/ai/improve-description, approve/reject). Upload via POST /api/supporting-documents/upload (R2)+room map. Circular per-file progress, ✅ on success; block modal close mid-upload (friendly message). Errors per-file: shadcn error w/ animated copy-to-clipboard (wrapped as AI-fix prompt) + Retry; one failure must not block others.
tasks.acceptance: Multi-file upload with independent progress/errors; AI description approve flow; modal locked during upload.

tasks.title: Mobile + accessibility pass on both pages
tasks.detail: 375/768/1024px; focus traps in dialogs; keyboard for switch/tabs/stat-anchors; ErrorLogger on all errors; no window.alert/confirm.
tasks.acceptance: Both pages clean on mobile; a11y basics pass.

tasks.title: End-to-end verification against deployed preview (Chrome DevTools MCP)
tasks.detail: Verify the user's family-room & guest-bedroom photos now show; all acceptance criteria in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN Section 15. Quick visual confirm of moved dots (upper-dining-room (84,62), upper-kitchen left, upper-hall-bath up, office swap) per R-4.
tasks.acceptance: All Section 15 criteria pass on the live worker URL.
